en: Colorized historic view of a wide tree-lined boulevard with tram tracks and an early electric tram in the center, pedestrians and horse-drawn vehicles, surrounded by multi‑story 19th‑century buildings. Two church or tower spires rise in the background on the left and right. At the top right there is printed text in Russian and German indicating the scene is Alexander Boulevard in Riga.
